faqs.question: What video formats does Video Caddy support for editing?
faqs.answer: Video Caddy supports a wide range of video formats, including but not limited to MP4, AVI, MOV, WMV, and FLV. If you have a specific format or codec requirement, please contact them for confirmation.

faqs.question: What software tools does Video Caddy use for video editing?
faqs.answer: Video Caddy editors work with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and After Effects across YouTube video editing engagements. These tools support the editing, color grading, motion graphics, and audio workflows applied throughout the production process. AI-assisted workflow tools are used where applicable to support rough-cut preparation and timeline organization, with all outputs subject to human editorial review before delivery.

faqs.question: How does Video Caddy handle color correction and grading?
faqs.answer: Video Caddy employs advanced color grading tools within DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere Pro to adjust color balance, saturation, and contrast, ensuring a high-quality cinematic experience.

faqs.question: Can Video Caddy handle 4K and higher resolution footage?
faqs.answer: Yes, Video Caddy is fully equipped to edit 4K resolution projects and has the capability to work with higher resolutions, ensuring no loss in quality during the editing process.

faqs.question: What techniques are used for video stabilization?
faqs.answer: Video Caddy uses software-based stabilization techniques using tools like Adobe Premiere Pro's Warp Stabilizer and DaVinci Resolve's stabilization feature to correct jitters and create smooth footage.

faqs.question: What types of YouTube videos can Video Caddy edit?
faqs.answer: We edit tutorials, vlogs, podcasts, interviews, product demos, webinars, gaming videos, and branded YouTube content, optimizing them for viewer engagement and platform standards.

faqs.question: How long does the YouTube video editing process take?
faqs.answer: Turnaround time depends on video length and complexity. Standard projects are typically delivered within 24 to 72 hours, with timelines confirmed after review.

faqs.question: What is included in your YouTube video editing packages?
faqs.answer: Packages include cutting, transitions, motion graphics, subtitles, audio cleanup, color correction, branding elements, and export optimized for YouTube algorithms.

faqs.question: Can you edit long-form and short-form content (YouTube Shorts)?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle long-form YouTube videos and Shorts, repurposing content for maximum reach, watch time, and cross-platform engagement.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of outsourcing youtube video editing?
faqs.answer: Outsourcing YouTube video editing to a structured provider reduces in-house editing overhead, supports more consistent turnaround across recurring content, and allows internal teams to focus on content strategy and channel growth. Video Caddy's AI-augmented editing workflows combine workflow-assisted processing with human editorial review to help marketing teams improve post-production visibility and reduce coordination effort across publishing cycles.
